2608.28233.title: REINS: Refusal-Enhanced Inhibitory Steering with Sparse Autoencoder Features
2608.28233.paper_summary: Steering with Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) offers a lightweight inference-time path for adapting the behavior of large language models without retraining. By exposing sparse and interpretable features, SAE steering provides a promising interface for safety control that guides harmful continuations toward refusal. However, we observe that complex wrappers can still undermine existing SAE steering methods on harmful prompts. To evaluate this failure mode systematically, we construct Generalized Undercover Instruction Safety Evaluation (GUISE), a dataset of harmful prompts with complex wrappers. Existing single direction SAE steering methods do not reliably produce refusals on harmful prompts, suggesting that refusal enhancement alone can be too weak when the harmful continuation path remains active. This motivates us to propose Refusal-Enhanced INhibitory Steering (REINS), which suppresses harmful continuation features and enhances safe refusal features in the same SAE feature space. Experiments on GUISE and other datasets show that prior methods either intervene too weakly or achieve only apparent safety through collapse, while REINS substantially reduces harmful responses, markedly improves safe refusals and largely preserves general capabilities.
2608.28233.paper_summary_zh: 使用稀疏自編碼器（SAE）進行引導提供了一種輕量級的推理時間路徑，可以在不重新訓練的情況下調整大型語言模型的行為。<lb/>通過揭示稀疏且可解釋的特徵，SAE 引導提供了一個有前景的安全控制介面，能夠將有害的延續引導至拒絕。<lb/>然而，我們觀察到複雜的包裝仍然可能削弱現有的 SAE 引導方法在有害提示上的效果。<lb/>為了系統地評估這種失效模式，我們構建了廣義潛藏指令安全評估（GUISE），這是一個包含複雜包裝的有害提示數據集。<lb/>現有的單向 SAE 引導方法在有害提示上並不可靠地產生拒絕，這表明僅僅增強拒絕可能在有害延續路徑仍然活躍時過於薄弱。<lb/>這促使我們提出拒絕增強抑制引導（REINS），該方法在相同的 SAE 特徵空間中抑制有害延續特徵並增強安全拒絕特徵。<lb/>在 GUISE 和其他數據集上的實驗顯示，先前的方法要麼干預過於薄弱，要麼僅通過崩潰實現表面安全，而 REINS 顯著減少有害反應，顯著改善安全拒絕，並在很大程度上保留一般能力。
